sentences.text: Agentic AI is live at Deutsche Bank, whose private bank uses it to assemble source of wealth assessments, and at TD Bank, cutting first-draft commercial credit analysis from days to under 30 minutes.
Against financial crime, Lloyds has deployed agentic AI in fraud detection, and Starling an agentic investigator it says completes an investigation within 17 seconds.
In lending and operations, Deutsche Bank is cutting some corporate loan decisions from weeks to minutes, and JPMorgan has automated lockbox check and remittance processing.
In pilots, Visa lets AI agents complete approved invoice payments via supplier portals, and Customers Bank closed select commercial loans in seven days.
